name: Presumed Guilty!
summary: "Presumed Guilty!" puts you in the role of a secret agent caught in a dangerous conspiracy. It all starts with the mysterious death of the head of the top-secret S.D.I. research project "New-Wave." As an investigator for the Computer Operated Police Network (COPNET), you are assigned to the case – but soon find yourself the prime suspect. Using audio clues and the extensive COPNET database, you must gather evidence, conduct DNA analyses, and examine personal records and police reports to prove your innocence. With each discovery, a complex web of intrigue unfolds, and time is running out to uncover the truth.
